Module org.example.froggergame
Package org.example.froggergame

Class GameConfig

java.lang.Object
org.example.froggergame.GameConfig
public class GameConfig extends Object
Represents the configuration settings for the Frogger game.

The GameConfig class contains various settings such as game difficulty, level, lives, speed multiplier, character selection, and audio settings. These settings can be used to customize the game experience.
